overview.description: The First Eagle Core Municipal ETF (FECM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in investment-grade municipal bonds. The fund seeks federally tax-exempt income while actively managing duration, credit exposure, and portfolio risk. FECM was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by First Eagle.
